services.title: Residential Roofing Services Near Columbus, OH
services.description: From roof repairs to a complete replacement, our Columbus team brings together professional installation, roofing product choices and written workmanship coverage. Explore each service, then see what our customers and industry credentials say about working with Roof King.

items.title: Does Your Roof Need Repair or Replacement?
items.description: Find out whether your roof’s symptoms point to a repair or a full replacement. Learn how leaks, missing shingles and damaged flashing are assessed, and what goes into repairing the affected area.
items.detail: Roof King’s repair service includes an inspection, removal of damaged materials and installation of replacement roofing where needed. See how the process works and how our five-year workmanship coverage supports the repair.
items.label: Learn about roof repair

items.title: Complete Residential Roof Replacement
items.description: Our replacement service takes your project from roof inspection and material selection through tear-off, installation, cleanup and a final walkthrough. We review decking, flashing and ventilation as part of planning the new roof system.
items.detail: Choose from asphalt and architectural shingles, GAF roofing systems and metal roofing options. The replacement page brings together the installation process, cost factors, financing and written warranty information.
items.label: Explore roof replacement

items.title: See What Affects the Cost of a New Roof
items.description: Find out how roof size, pitch, materials and installation complexity affect a replacement estimate. See where tear-off, underlayment, flashing, permits and disposal fit into the cost.
items.detail: Compare the factors behind different proposals, including labor and warranty selections. Our cost guide and roofing calculator help you prepare a budget before getting an estimate for your home.
items.label: Explore roof cost factors

items.title: Roof King’s Online Roofing Estimator

items.title: Why Choose a GAF Master Elite Roofer?
items.description: Learn what GAF Master Elite certification means when choosing a roofing company. Explore the contractor credentials, insurance and ongoing training discussed in our certification guide.

items.title: Explore Metal Roofing for Your Home
items.description: Compare the appearance, longevity, reflective properties and maintenance considerations of metal roofing. Learn about installation by Roof King and how this option differs from an asphalt shingle roof.

items.label: Explore metal roofing

items.title: Roof and Exterior Storm Damage Restoration
items.description: Learn how Roof King restores roofing and siding after hail, wind and ice damage, from exterior repairs to replacement work. Explore help for damage involving shingles, gutters and other exterior materials.
items.detail: See how our storm restoration and insurance claims assistance services work together. We can help document and discuss the damage; coverage decisions remain with your insurer and policy.
highlights: Hail, wind and ice damage restoration

faq.title: Before you plan your roof.

items.question: What residential roofing services does Roof King provide?

children.text: Our residential roofing services include roof repair, complete replacement, GAF roofing installation, metal roofing and storm damage restoration. Explore the service pages for installation details, product options and the coverage to discuss with your project estimate.

items.question: What should I compare in roofing estimates?

children.text: Check whether each roofing estimate includes tear-off and disposal, decking repairs, underlayment, flashing, ventilation, shingles or panels, and cleanup. Review the written warranties and ask how unexpected decking damage would be priced and approved.

items.question: Can I compare shingles and metal roofing?

children.text: Yes. Browse shingle styles and colors, or explore metal roof panels and finishes. Discuss fastening, flashing, ventilation, maintenance and product-specific warranty terms with our team.

Roof King publishes five-year workmanship coverage. Manufacturer warranties apply separately to the selected products or eligible systems. Review the written terms and eligibility for the exact project in your estimate.

items.question: What if I noticed damage after a storm?

children.text: Contact the team to discuss an inspection and share what you can observe safely from the ground. Inspection findings can inform the proposed repair or restoration work. Insurance coverage depends on your policy and insurer.
Yes. Ask for current options, then review lender rates, approval requirements and repayment terms before you apply. Available financing does not replace a project-specific estimate.
